items.title: Researchers Hack Volkswagen Cars via Bluetooth to Spy on Conversations and Track GPS Locations
items.description: Bluetooth flaws in Volkswagen cars could expose private conversations, reveal GPS locations, and allow unauthorized control of cabin features. The findings highlight a lengthy patch rollout, with some vehicles remaining exposed roughly 16 months after the vulnerabilities became public. items.title: Cleverbridge Confirms Hackers Stole Customer Card Numbers and CVV Codes in a Major Data Breach
items.description: Cleverbridge confirmed that hackers copied payment card data from its e-commerce platform. The stolen information includes card numbers, expiration dates, and CVV or CVC security codes. Cleverbridge’s public update does not list those fields or say whether the same details were exposed for every affected customer.
